description: Assumed molten-electrolyte methane-oxidation cell screening conditions; not measurements.

feed.source: pure methane feed; representative operating point (assumed, uncalibrated); see moose/operating_points/README.md

electrolyte.source: Janz, NIST Molten Salts Database / Claes & Glibert, J. Electrochem. Soc. 132 (1985) 857 (NaOH-KOH eutectic); see moose/operating_points/README.md

parameter_sources.geometry.electrode_area_m2: 10 cm^2 planar laboratory test cell standard; see moose/operating_points/README.md
parameter_sources.geometry.electrolyte_thickness_m: 0.5 mm inter-electrode gap representative operating point; see moose/operating_points/README.md
parameter_sources.operating.pressure_Pa: 1 atm standard ambient pressure (101325 Pa); see moose/operating_points/README.md
parameter_sources.operating.methane_mass_flow_kg_s: representative laboratory CH4 feed flow (1e-7 kg/s); see moose/operating_points/README.md
parameter_sources.operating.applied_potential_V: 0.9 V cell voltage benchmark operating point; see moose/operating_points/README.md
parameter_sources.properties.ionic_conductivity_S_m: Janz, NIST Molten Salts Database (~150 S/m for molten NaOH-KOH eutectic at 600-850 K)
parameter_sources.properties.electronic_conductivity_S_m: metallic current collector/catalyst layer (~10^5 S/m); see moose/operating_points/README.md
parameter_sources.properties.methane_diffusivity_m2_s: Stokes-Einstein molten hydroxide estimate (~5e-9 m^2/s); see moose/operating_points/README.md
